gumtree_entries.description: UPDATED o1 -> i1: This file was automatically generated by EvoSuite Tue Jun 16 03:50:02 GMT 2026
ADDED i2: parse() rejects non ISO-8601 text (here a buffer of NUL characters) by throwing a DateTimeParseException.
ADDED i5: Two Years built from different routes but holding the same amount (-1) are equal to each other, yet neither equals the unrelated ONE instance.
ADDED i6: equals(null) returns false and does not disturb the amount.
ADDED i7: equals() is reflexive: an instance equals itself.
ADDED i8: Dividing ONE by 498 yields zero years, which is not equal to ONE.
ADDED i9: subtractFrom() with a non-zero amount returns a new (different) temporal.
ADDED i10: subtractFrom() of a zero-amount Years leaves the (null) temporal untouched.
ADDED i11: addTo() of a non-zero amount needs a real temporal; a null target triggers a NullPointerException.
ADDED i14: addTo() of a zero-amount Years is a no-op and leaves the amount unchanged.
ADDED i15: abs() turns a negative amount into its positive counterpart while leaving the original instance unchanged.
ADDED i16: abs() of an already-positive amount returns the same amount.
ADDED i17: Dividing ONE by 1 returns the same one-year amount, which is not zero.
ADDED i18: Multiplying by the scalar 1 keeps the amount unchanged.
ADDED i19: Subtracting a zero-amount Years from ONE leaves ONE unchanged.
ADDED i20: Adding ZERO to ZERO yields zero years.
ADDED i21: ZERO is not positive but is zero.
ADDED i22: isZero() is true for an amount of zero.
ADDED i23: isZero() is false for a non-zero amount.
ADDED i24: Dividing ONE by -1 produces a negative amount, so isNegative() is true.
ADDED i25: isNegative() is false for a zero amount.
ADDED i26: Years exposes only the YEARS unit, which has an estimated duration, so Duration.from() cannot build a Duration from it.
ADDED i29: get() only supports the YEARS unit; a null unit is unsupported.
ADDED i32: Parsing "P0Y" - mirrors the original EvoSuite test, which guards against an unstable IllegalStateException from the underlying regex matcher.
ADDED i36: Subtracting a Period of -1 year from ZERO gives +1 year, leaving the original ZERO instance unchanged.
ADDED i37: from() rejects a Period whose month/day components cannot be reduced to a whole number of years.
ADDED i40: compareTo() of an instance against itself returns 0.
ADDED i41: The number of years between a date and itself is zero.
ADDED i42: hashCode() can be invoked without error.
ADDED i43: toString() of ZERO renders the ISO-8601 form "P0Y".
ADDED i44: toPeriod() returns a non-null Period for ONE year.
